sentences.text: This animal belongs to a group of extinct dinosaurs known as ornithopods.
Scientific studies place it as one of the earliest members of this group, standing just outside the Iguanodontia family tree.
It holds the title of the first officially recognized dinosaur found in modern-day Czech lands.
Researchers identified the species based on a single thigh bone uncovered in 2003.
The name was officially announced in 2017, paying tribute to artist Zdeněk Burian and scientist Josef Augusta.
Before its formal description, experts in 2005 thought the bone might belong to an iguanodont.
This creature roamed the Peruc-Korycany Formation between 100.5 and 93.9 million years ago during the Cenomanian stage.
